independentCPUClosure.model: Uniform mechanical pressure inside one mixed control volume. Separate constrained liquid and gas equations give combined compliance Cw+Cg. Gas volume changes by minus the corrected water inflow plus Cw times its pressure change.

operatorCheck: One gas/mixed-water row and one finite-compliance ordinary-water row. Matrix [[Cn+k,-k],[-k,Cw+Cg+k]]. RHS [Cn*pN_old-F,Cw*pW_old+Cg*pG_old+F]. Linear pressure is checked by independent elimination; nonlinear isothermal pressure by bisection of EOS, corrected face flux and liquid compliance. Gas base volume uses actual fixed-point encoding. Both face directions, positive/negative/zero provisional inflow, two liquid densities and two sound speeds are exercised.
limits: Private one-way singleton prototype only. No released pressure, phase, native water or overlay runtime change.
Only resolved positive gas volume at or above one encoded volume unit is retained. Subquantum/zero-volume gas and general collapse remain unresolved.
The reverse phase threshold still changes the liquid compliance contribution, so classification-independent force continuity is not established.
MAC scatter and native particle gather are bypassed in these fixtures. Actual transformed GPU pressure kernels and face projection are used, with prescribed records.

MAC face density is measured from the solver for the matrix oracle. This proves the encoded pressure operator, not the physical accuracy of liquid-interface inertia. Its whole-cell support approximation remains open.
Changed solid coverage and nonzero wall speed are rejected before writes in this prototype. Prescribed face opening and room-mask changes remain allowed; static tile-basis mutations are not covered.
Adjacent retained-root interfaces preserve inventory but report unsupported connectivity and unresolved phase. Their force coupling is not implemented.
No broad advection, split/merge, moving-solid, natural bubble, physical pressure/energy calibration or performance acceptance. Full Water Machines goal remains open.
